title: Build the Circle page to the new Circles design

verify.evidence: Probe fails on main (no cover, tab pill or side column) and passes here. Fixture renders at 1280 and 390 checked beside the design; no production data on the build box, so no real-data render.

detail: The Circle page and its four tabs follow the new design. Cover with the next meetups as date cards and in-place RSVP, sticky tab pill with counts, a two-column body with About, How we do it, How we meet, Who's here and Channels beside the feed. Members gets search, Everyone/New chips, Holding the circle, streak nudges and a seats card. What's happening gets a practice panel and date-tile rows. Stats gets weeks together and challenges. Every existing control is kept. Member area only: no Space website theme reaches it. Where the design shows data the app does not hold (ranks, a meetup photo), it is left out rather than faked. No migration.
